optimizedContext.value:
# Get Project Summary

## Rules
- `GetProjectSummary.execute()` → `GetProjectSummaryResult`: `activeCount`, `draftCount`, `discardedCount`, `archivedCount`, `specsByWorkspace` (name→count), `workspaceCount`
- MUST NOT include change entities, spec metadata, graph data, or context payloads
- Counts via: `ChangeRepository.count()` / `countDrafts()` / `countDiscarded()`; archived via `ArchiveRepository.count()` or `ListArchived.execute().meta.total`
- MUST NOT call `ListChanges`/`ListDrafts`/`ListDiscarded.execute()` just to measure `.length`
- `archivedCount` MUST NOT use `items.length` when `meta.total` available
- Spec counts: `ListWorkspaces.execute()` then `SpecRepository.count()` per `specRepo`; key by workspace `name`; preserve declaration order
- MUST NOT call `ListSpecs.execute()` or materialize list entries to count
- `workspaceCount` = workspaces from `ListWorkspaces`
- MUST parallelize independent counts (e.g. `Promise.all`)
- Constructor deps for count ports + `ListWorkspaces`; MUST NOT construct repos or read `specd.yaml` directly
- `createGetProjectSummary(config)` wires from `SpecdConfig` like other `createList*` factories
- Summary wiring MUST preserve complete downstream bootstrap (schema-driven change repos + canonical metadata-path spec repos); MUST NOT alternate/partial bootstrap
- `createKernel()` wires on `kernel.project.getProjectSummary`
- Config form → `resolveGetProjectSummaryDeps(resolver)` → `createGetProjectSummary(deps)`
- Resolve: `changes: ChangeRepository`, `archive: ArchiveRepository`, `listWorkspaces: ListWorkspaces`
- MUST NOT resolve `listChanges`/`listDrafts`/`listDiscarded`/`listArchived` — counts from repo `count*` APIs, never list-length
- MUST NOT inline fs wiring

## Constraints
- MUST NOT invoke code-graph providers or context compilation
- MUST NOT load spec metadata, change artifact content, or materialize list entries
- MUST NOT mutate config, repositories, or stored changes
